scheme_name: Mrityu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana
description:
Mrityu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Uttar Pradesh. 

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2021. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the families of individuals who have passed away due to COVID-19. 

The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden associated with funeral expenses during a time of grief. 

Under this scheme, the government provides a financial assistance of ₹50,000. 

This amount is intended to cover the costs of last rites and other related expenses. 

The assistance is provided directly to the bank account of the deceased's family member. 

The scheme is particularly significant given the economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on families. 

It aims to ensure that no family is left in distress due to the inability to afford funeral costs. 

Eligibility for the scheme is primarily based on the cause of death. 

Families of individuals who died due to COVID-19 are eligible for this assistance. 

There are no specific age limits set for the deceased. 

However, the applicant must be a legal heir of the deceased individual. 

The applicant must provide proof of relationship to the deceased. 

Income criteria are not explicitly defined for this scheme. 

This means that families from all economic backgrounds can apply for assistance. 

The application process is designed to be straightforward and accessible. 

Applicants must visit the official website of the Uttar Pradesh government. 

They need to fill out the application form available online. 

The application form requires details such as the name of the deceased, date of death, and the relationship of the applicant to the deceased. 

Additionally, the applicant must upload necessary documents. 

These documents include a death certificate, proof of relationship, and bank account details. 

The death certificate must be issued by a recognized authority. 

It is crucial that the application is submitted within a specific timeframe. 

Applications must be submitted within 60 days of the death of the individual. 

This ensures timely disbursement of funds to the grieving families. 

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes verification by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 days. 

Upon successful verification, the financial assistance is disbursed. 

Funds are transferred directly to the bank account provided in the application. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the helpline number provided on the official website. 

The helpline operates from 9 AM to 6 PM on weekdays. 

The government has also set up dedicated offices in various districts to assist applicants. 

These offices are equipped to handle inquiries and provide guidance on the application process. 

The scheme has been well-received by the public. 

Many families have expressed gratitude for the financial support during their time of loss. 

The government has reported that thousands of applications have been received since the launch. 

As of October 2023, over ₹200 crores have been disbursed under this scheme. 

This amount has benefited families across various districts in Uttar Pradesh. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the government to support citizens during the pandemic. 

Other welfare measures have also been introduced to assist families affected by COVID-19. 

The government emphasizes the importance of community support during such challenging times. 

It encourages citizens to spread awareness about the scheme. 

This ensures that eligible families are informed and can avail of the benefits. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to social welfare and support. 

It aims to provide a safety net for families during unforeseen circumstances. 

The financial assistance can significantly ease the burden of funeral expenses. 

It allows families to focus on mourning and healing rather than financial stress. 

Overall, Mrityu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana is a crucial initiative. 

It addresses a pressing need in society during a time of crisis. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's responsiveness to the needs of its citizens. 

It showcases how welfare schemes can play a vital role in providing support during emergencies. 

The ongoing monitoring and evaluation of the scheme ensure its effectiveness. 

The government remains committed to making necessary adjustments based on feedback. 

This adaptability is essential for the success of welfare initiatives. 

In conclusion, the Mrityu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana is a significant step towards providing financial relief. 

It is aimed at helping families cope with the loss of loved ones due to COVID-19. 

The scheme not only offers monetary assistance but also conveys a message of solidarity. 

It reinforces the idea that the government stands with its citizens in times of need. 

The initiative is a critical component of the broader welfare framework in Uttar Pradesh. 

It highlights the importance of timely support and intervention in crisis situations. 

Families are encouraged to utilize this scheme to ease their financial burdens. 

The government continues to promote awareness and accessibility of the scheme. 

This ensures that those in need can benefit from the assistance provided. 

The Mrityu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana exemplifies the role of government in social welfare. 

It is a vital resource for families navigating the challenges posed by the pandemic.
